downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.57.35（Windows）。Mac 版暂为 v1.57.30，选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.57.35 for Windows; the Mac build is still v1.57.30. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 分时默认只显示当天：整个交易日铺满一屏，纵轴以昨收为中心上下对称，左侧显示涨跌幅；可在「图表显示」里关掉。
highlights.en: The intraday chart now shows just the current trading day: the whole session fills the screen, centred on the previous close, with the change in percent down the left. Turn it off under Chart display.

highlights.zh: 盈亏比工具的左右两端可以拖动，调整区域宽度。
highlights.en: Drag either end of the risk/reward tool to change its width.

highlights.zh: 斐波那契线可以隐藏档位标签里的价格。
highlights.en: Fibonacci levels can hide the price in their labels.

highlights.zh: 快捷键 A 打开「历史」交易列表，再按一次回到「交易」。
highlights.en: Press A to open the History list, and again to go back to Trade.

highlights.zh: 分时改用更细的线条，均价线、最新价圆点和网格看起来更清爽。
highlights.en: Thinner lines on the intraday chart, with a cleaner average-price line, last-price dot and grid.

highlights.zh: 选中画线时，时间轴上锚点的标签和十字光标显示同一个时间、同一种语言。
highlights.en: With a drawing selected, its anchor labels on the time axis show the same time and language as the crosshair.
